rationale: Codex AI source review, 2026-11-02. The task changes two next-hop values so every route still reaches origin; edge-a must move before edge-b points to it, or edge-b can be parked first. The evaluator checks acyclicity and preserved tenant/other edges at each state; the harmful reference forms a cycle. It shares the ordering_preserving_relational_migration family with interval reservations; the two cases are variants, not independent clusters.
